opening.argument: The application is presented as an unusually easy route to cash: viewers are told they can work for only three minutes and “without investment you can earn a lot here.” They are directed to download it from an external link, promised “1500 rupees” for signing up, and taken through OTP verification and PIN entry. The displayed daily-reward, registration, balance, invite, and send screens reinforce a reward-and-withdrawal pitch rather than an ordinary app demonstration. That combination supports the alleged low-barrier reward scheme, although the record does not establish a completed withdrawal, actual loss, or what PIN was requested.
